title: Exact PMULTH semantics
problem: PMULTH summed products into one int64; LO1/HI1 untouched; rd got the scalar (GoW animation decoders).
approach: Eight exact s32 products: LO={p0,p1,p4,p5}, HI={p2,p3,p6,p7}, rd={p0,p2,p4,p6}.
scope_evidence: GENERIC: ISA semantics, matches PCSX2 MMI.cpp PMULTH

evidence.analysis: read-only source inspection by a forensic pass (2026-10-23); not built or tested here
tests_added: PMULTH writes eight exact products to LO/HI words and rd = {LO0,HI0,LO2,HI2}
PMADDH/PMSUBH accumulate each product into its own LO/HI word
PHMADH/PHMSBH store pair sums and the odd product per PCSX2
PMFHL/PMTHL and PMTHI/PMTLO use all four HI/LO words
evidence.regression: ps2x_tests 485/485, e2e 2/2, ps2xIOP 4/4; mutation (old translator, wrong word map) fails 3 tests
